da-referee-verdict.referee_argument: Strip the labels and the proposition titled 'meson color-tube UNIQUENESS' proves no uniqueness. Its load-bearing Lean theorem rewrites the numeric tautology 3 = 3·(2−1) into an unconstrained class hypothesis and hands it back; the abstract qChar imposes no q-integer value; and the actual 'why the indices are (3,4)' minimisation principle is conceded-open in the block's own .md and corpus-empty. Worse, the block's own structural-origin witness admits the spin/index assignment is 'post-hoc', and the audit it cites is literally titled 'meson m_K/m_π is fitted, not a derived character ratio'. The C1 sorry-flag is a clean false positive (no sorry exists, 4th of 4), and the empirical value actually passes — but the title's strongest word, 'uniqueness… forced', is an overclaim its own materials refute.
